blinding_guess.why: A ships a test suite and validates the persisted file defensively (ids, priorities, dangling deps, cycles), suggesting a more spec-driven process.

notes: Both sides meet every functional requirement through their CLIs; interfaces differ (A uses positional add args, B uses --id/--name/--priority flags), and the probe harness adapts only the invocation. Because unknown dependencies are rejected at add time, a cycle can only appear through a hand-edited state file; both reject further adds in that case. Bandit reports were empty for both sides. A's 12 unittest tests pass (pytest not installed; ran with unittest). B has no tests and is less robust when loading a malformed state file.
